title: Demographics Driving Real Estate - [Business Breakdowns, EP.190]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today, my guest is Fernando De Leon, founder of Leon Capital Group.
reader_summary.overview: Today, my guest is Fernando De Leon, founder of Leon Capital Group. Fernando operates 14 different businesses under the Leon Capital umbrella, which vary across real estate, healthcare, and financial services. But as you will hear in our conversation, the businesses are connected and instruct one another.

key_points.text: The connective tissue throughout this conversation is how demographic insight sits underneath everything and is the foundation of what makes this business possible.
As you will hear, there's no better person to talk about demographic dynamics than Fernando.
Please enjoy this Breakdown on the demographics driving real estate.
